newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain stocks retreat off record highs.
newsitem.headline: Bahrain stocks retreat off record highs.

text.p: Bahrain's stock market retreated from recent record highs in the week to Thursday, with the index ending fractionally lower in thinner trade.
The Bahrain Stock Exchange said the index ended the week at 1,534.42 points, down from an all-time high 1,539.23 points a week earlier.
Trading volume dropped sharply to 12.8 million shares worth 3.13 million dinars from the record 27.4 million shares worth 5.3 million dinars seen the previous week.

The bourse said Bahrain International Bank (BIB) shares again dominated trade with more than 5.5 million shares worth 913,029 dinars changing hands. BIB extended recent gains and was last quoted at 165 fils from the previous week's 159 fil close.
Investcorp followed, with 1.16 million shares worth 769,125 dinars changing hands. It was last traded at $1.77.
Shares of 17 firms of the 39 registered at the bourse were traded in 311 transactions.
Bahrain's market is open to nationals in Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, Oman, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates. Certain firms are also open to foreign investors.
